name: simple_control
sql: SELECT id FROM anchors WHERE id=?

name: in_subquery_scope
sql: SELECT id FROM anchors WHERE arch_type IN (SELECT type_name FROM graph_types WHERE ancestor=?)

name: union_scope_without_in_subquery
sql: SELECT n.id,e.id FROM (SELECT e.* FROM anchors e WHERE e.src=? UNION ALL SELECT e.* FROM anchors e WHERE e.dst=?) e JOIN anchors n ON n.id=e.src WHERE n.arch_type=?

name: actual_first_knows_hop
sql: SELECT n.id,e.id FROM (SELECT e.* FROM anchors e WHERE e.src=? AND e.kind='EdgeAnchor' AND (e.arch_type=? OR e.arch_type IN(SELECT type_name FROM graph_types WHERE ancestor=?)) AND (e.dst_type IS NULL OR e.dst_type=? OR e.dst_type IN(SELECT type_name FROM graph_types WHERE ancestor=?)) UNION ALL SELECT e.* FROM anchors e WHERE e.dst=? AND e.undirected=1 AND e.src<>e.dst AND e.kind='EdgeAnchor' AND (e.arch_type=? OR e.arch_type IN(SELECT type_name FROM graph_types WHERE ancestor=?)) AND (e.src_type IS NULL OR e.src_type=? OR e.src_type IN(SELECT type_name FROM graph_types WHERE ancestor=?))) e JOIN anchors n ON n.id=CASE WHEN e.src=? THEN e.dst ELSE e.src END AND n.kind='NodeAnchor' AND (n.arch_type=? OR n.arch_type IN(SELECT type_name FROM graph_types WHERE ancestor=?)) ORDER BY e.seq,e.id
